## Reproduction

Describe the smallest steps. For model import issues, use a synthetic example or describe the structure; do not upload third-party models without redistribution rights.

## Sanitised evidence

Relevant error and redacted diagnostics. Remove addresses/device identifiers if private. Never include tokens, PINs, Wi-Fi passwords or full flash backups.

## Output state

Was output stopped afterwards? Were other senders or native tests active?
